title: Fix dashboard query-settled loading and robust mobile Sheet overlay/lifecycle

requirements.summary: Ensure Dashboard stops loading on tests query error, clears activation overlay on query settle, and shows an error state with retry.
acceptanceCriteria: If fetching test configs fails (React Query error), the Dashboard does not remain on the loading skeleton indefinitely.
When the tests query errors, the Dashboard renders an error state (English text) indicating tests could not be loaded and provides a Retry button that re-attempts the fetch.
View activation completion is not blocked by a failed tests fetch (i.e., any view-activation overlay is cleared once queries are settled, not only on success).
When the tests fetch later succeeds after retry, the normal dashboard content renders without requiring a hard refresh.

file_operations.description: Update the tests React Query consumption to use settled state (success OR error) rather than only loading flags: read tests query error/isError/isFetched/refetch, call finishActivation when the profile query and tests query are settled, and render a dedicated error UI when tests cannot be loaded (clear message + Retry button wired to refetch) so the skeleton/spinner cannot remain indefinitely.

requirements.summary: Make the mobile Sheet menu always render with a full-viewport dimmed overlay and correct stacking behind the panel but above content.
acceptanceCriteria: Opening the mobile menu on small screens always shows the underlying page dimmed by a non-transparent overlay covering the full viewport.
The menu panel background remains opaque (not transparent) on mobile.
Tapping outside the menu (on the overlay) closes the menu reliably.
The overlay/menu z-index stacking prevents the page from appearing blank/transparent and prevents page-shift artifacts while the menu is open.

file_operations.description: Fix Sheet composition so an overlay/backdrop is always present and correctly layered: ensure the Sheet renders an overlay element (prefer using the exported SheetOverlay from the existing shadcn Sheet composition if available) with fixed positioning (inset-0), a dark semi-transparent background, and z-index below the menu panel but above page content; keep the panel background explicitly opaque via existing classes.

Add/adjust global CSS overrides (without touching frontend/src/components/ui) to guarantee the mobile Sheet overlay covers the viewport and stacks correctly: enforce fixed inset-0, non-transparent dark backdrop styling, and stable z-index for the overlay and .mobile-menu-sheet-content so the page never appears transparent/blank under the menu.

requirements.summary: Harden the mobile Sheet open/close lifecycle by resetting menu state on navigation and during view activation to prevent intermediate visual states.
acceptanceCriteria: Navigating via any mobile menu action closes the menu before switching views.
If view activation starts while the menu is open, the menu closes and the UI returns to a stable non-blank state.
No regressions to desktop navigation behavior.

file_operations.description: Strengthen mobile menu lifecycle handling: close the Sheet before any navigation action (ensure close happens synchronously before calling onNavigate), and add guards/effects that reset mobileMenuOpen when currentView changes and when activation state begins, preventing any transient/blank state if activation triggers while the menu is open.

Ensure view activation transitions remain stable even if a view's data fetch fails: keep activation completion independent of a successful fetch by relying on each view to finish activation on settled queries (and maintain existing safety timeout), so navigation/activation cannot be visually blocked by mobile menu state changes.
